convert_clvp_weights: convert CLVP model weights from Tortoise TTS checkpoints to HuggingFace transformers format
convert_encoder_weights: convert encoder weights from original CLVP checkpoint format to HuggingFace model state dict keys
convert_decoder_weights: convert decoder weights from original CLVP checkpoint format to HuggingFace model state dict keys
download_clvp_checkpoints: download CLVP and decoder checkpoint files from HuggingFace Hub when missing from local path
run_conversion_cli: run the CLVP weight conversion script via argparse with checkpoint path and output folder arguments
